description: This source file defines the `VoiceWakeForwarder` enum which provides functions and types related to forwarding voice wake commands, including transcript processing, error handling, and network communication via a gateway connection.

classes.name: VoiceWakeForwardError
classes.description: An error enum conforming to LocalizedError and Equatable, representing possible failure states for voice wake forwarding, such as RPC failures.

classes.name: ForwardOptions
classes.description: A configuration struct for forwarding options including session key, thinking level, delivery flag, target recipient, and communication channel.

methods.name: prefixedTranscript
methods.description: Generates a transcript string with a prefix indicating the machine name or default identifier.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Asynchronously sends a voice transcript to the gateway with specified options, returning success or a detailed error.

methods.name: checkConnection
methods.description: Checks the connection status to the gateway and returns success or an error indicating failure.
